summary: Yemeni government forces, backed by Saudi Arabia, launched a major offensive retaking Houthi-held territory in Marib and advancing toward the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait. Simultaneously, rocket barrages struck Riyadh and the Aramco refinery in Jeddah, while the IDF eliminated a senior Hamas Nukhba commander in Gaza. Multiple attempted vehicle-ramming attacks occurred in the West Bank without Israeli casualties.
key_points: Yemeni government forces, supported by Saudi air power, recaptured Houthi-held areas in Marib and advanced toward Bab al-Mandab, capturing Dhubab and its airport. (Source: @New_security8200/204115)
Rocket barrages hit the Saudi capital Riyadh, halting airport operations, and struck the Aramco oil refinery in Jeddah. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92649, @naya_foriraq/92658)
US officials evacuated B-1 bombers from a British base due to threats of Iranian drone attacks. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92657)
IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Hamas Nukhba platoon commander Ibrahim Abu Awimer in a strike in Nuseirat, central Gaza. (Source: @New_security8200/204103)
Attempted car-ramming attacks occurred near Bani Naim and Michmash in the West Bank with no Israeli injuries reported. (Source: @manniefabian/59317, @yediotnews25/135819)
Iranian air defense activity was reported over the Al-Mahdi IRGC base in Urmia, West Azerbaijan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/10807)
UKMTO reported a tanker struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing an engine room fire. (Source: @presstv/209618)
Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan agreed to rapidly deploy military forces and capabilities to Saudi Arabia. (Source: @N12chat/228586)

points: Iran executed two individuals, Ali-Reza Sepahi and Ali-Reza Raisi, for involvement in January anti-regime riots in Tehran. (Source: @asafroz/54058)
Iranian air defense systems engaged over the Al-Mahdi IRGC base in Urmia, West Azerbaijan Province, according to delayed monitoring. (Source: @shin_persian/10807)

IRGC naval forces declared that vessels must obtain permission to transit the Strait of Hormuz and are restricted to the northern route, claiming 13 tankers were targeted in the southern route over the past week. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/397379)
A US official stated the United States is intensifying its siege on Iran. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81996)
US B-1 bombers were evacuated from a British base due to perceived Iranian drone threats. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92657)
Former President Trump accused Iran of responsibility for the attempted flydubai flight attack. (Source: @amitsegal/65540)
Iran's SNSC Secretary Major General Rezaei warned that any enemy miscalculation will open new fronts and bring greater surprises. (Source: @presstv/209622)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted an airstrike in Nuseirat, central Gaza, eliminating Hamas Nukhba platoon commander Ibrahim Abu Awimer, who participated in the October 7 attack and recently planned terror operations. (Source: @New_security8200/204103)

Israeli security forces responded to two attempted car-ramming attacks in the West Bank near Bani Naim and near Michmash, with no Israeli casualties reported. (Source: @manniefabian/59317, @yediotnews25/135819)
Duvdevan unit operators arrested two Palestinian weapons traders in the Kasbah of Nablus during a special operation. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94488)

Shin Bet interrogators traveled to the UAE to participate in questioning of the flydubai co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami who attempted a terror attack. (Source: @manniefabian/59322)
